The Factory Process Worker assists with the manufacture, preparation, handling and dispatch of engineered wood and timber-based products within a factory environment. The role involves operating basic production machinery and equipment within the workshop or factory environment, supporting production processes, handling materials, maintaining product quality, and ensuring a safe and organised workplace.

Position Description 
Perform general factory, production and labouring duties
Operate production machinery and equipment within the workshop or factory environment
Assist with production and manufacturing processes
Handle, move, stack and prepare materials and products
Assist with packing, wrapping, labelling and dispatch tasks
